area_title.doc: M2-UI-21 (intro audit 4): the area title card. When the field first takes input in a location (game/data/world/locations.json, found by the current scene's path) other than the one whose card was shown last, its name (name_key) fades in at the centre of the upper screen over a soft band, holds, and fades out. A cutscene or a conversation at the start delays it until the field takes input; a menu hides it. Returning to the title forgets the last location, so New Game and Continue show it again. skip_locations never get a card (test rooms). Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference (multiples of 3): 'name' is the label, 'rule' the centred gold rule under it, 'band' the dark band behind both (band_alpha at its middle, fading to 0 at its ends and over band_feather_px at its top and bottom). The rule is rule_px thick with a rule_node_px diamond. The card rises drift_px while it fades in (reduced motion: no rise). shadow_px offsets the name's shadow.
